hold.name: Hold course
hold.description: Sail on at an ordinary pace.

push.name: Push speed
push.description: Crowd on sail: a fifth faster, at the cost of the hull.

resupply.name: Resupply
resupply.description: Fish and trade with passing ships this month: half the progress, more stores.

detour.name: Detour to the nearest port
detour.description: Put in at whichever place is closest from here.

turn_back.name: Turn back
turn_back.description: Head back where you came from; the miles already sailed are lost.

modes.name: Your own ship
modes.description: You command the ship and choose the course every month.
modes.risk: Storms, mutiny, running out of money

modes.name: Sign on as crew
modes.description: Work your passage as a ship's hand. You earn a hand's wages, and go where the captain goes.

modes.name: Book passage
modes.description: Pay a fare for each month at sea and leave the sailing to others.
modes.risk: Being dropped at the wrong port

modes.name: Stow away
modes.description: Hide in a cargo hold and hope nobody looks. Free, until somebody looks.
modes.risk: Discovery: forced labour, or thrown overboard

modes.name: Marine transport
modes.description: Ride a Marine warship to your posting. Free for those who serve.
modes.risk: Orders, and pirates who hate the flag

modes.name: On foot
modes.description: Walk it, carrying your own food.

lines.missedNews: {amount} headlines were waiting for you in {destination}.
lines.witnessedAtSea: From the deck you saw it with your own eyes: {title}
lines.progress: Another month at sea: about {months} still to {destination}.
lines.wrecked: The {ship} broke apart and went down.
lines.castaway: You washed up on {destination}, half drowned, with nothing but what you were wearing.
lines.starving: The stores ran out. Everyone aboard went hungry.
lines.unpaid: There was no money for the crew's wages, and the grumbling below decks grew.
lines.diverted: The captain changed course for {destination}, and nobody asked your opinion.
lines.turnedBack: You put the helm over and turned back for {destination}.
lines.resupplied: You spent the month fishing and trading with passing ships, and stowed {amount} months of stores.
lines.jobLeft: You left your work as {job} behind.
lines.bought: You bought {title} and named her the {ship}.
lines.provisioned: You stocked the {ship} with {amount} months of stores.
lines.coated: The {ship}'s hull was sealed in resin for the dive into the deep sea.
lines.rescued: You were hauled back aboard, coughing up seawater.
